definitionZh: 这可以选择与 PreventScroll 一起使用。这定义了允许滚动的一个或多个轴，除非用户点击并按住该元素达指定的持续时间。此后，所有滚动都将被阻止。根据元素嵌套的复杂性，您可能需要将属性 touch-action: pan-x、touch-action: pan-y 或两者分配给元素以允许正确的行为。
sourceDefinition: This can optionally be used together with preventScroll. This defines the axis/axes in which scrolling is permitted, unless the user taps and holds on the element for the specified duration. Afterwhich, all scrolling is blocked. Depending on the complexity of the nesting of the element, you may need to assign the property touch-action: pan-x, touch-action: pan-y, or both, to the element to allow for the correct behavior.
